answers.core: Export variables are a core feature in GDScript.
answers.workaround:
```gdscript
@tool
extends Control

@export var my_node_path : NodePath

@export var rename_my_node : String:
	get: return rename_my_node
	set(v):
		rename_my_node = v
		get_node(my_node_path).name = v
```

This works fine enough, aside from the fact that initially setting it may crash Godot, but it works fine and doesn't after crash more then that initial time.

title: Resolve Node export variables earlier like NodePath export variables
